paragraphs.text: Chapter 3. Escape from the Lost City
Bagheera and Ka were now at the Lost City
We must be very careful. There are hundreds of monkeys, but there are only two of us.
I will go to the West Wall and attack them from up high.
Good luck, said Bagheera.
The Panther then went to fight the monkeys. He hit them very hard, but there were so many of them.
While this was happening, other monkeys dragged Mobley away.
There was nothing Mobley could do to help Bagheera. Then he had an idea.
Bagheera, go into that tank of water nearby. Monkeys won't attack you, they hate water.
Bagheera heard that and ran to the tank. He was happy that Mobley was safe.
At that moment, Balleu entered the Lost City. He started fighting the monkeys.
He was coming slowly down from the West Wall. He entered the circle of monkeys around Balleu.
It's Ka! It's Ka!
They screamed. All of the monkeys were very afraid. Pa spoke. Everything was silent.
Ka's one word was enough to make the Bandar log stop. Now Bagheera climbed out of the tank.
The monkeys will not move. Said Ka. Thank you Ka. Said Balleu and Bagheera.
You're welcome. Go and find the man cab. Said Ka.
Mobley, where are you? I am trapped. I am in this room and I cannot get out.
Cried Mobley. Ka hit the wall several times. Eventually he made a hole and Mobley came out through it.
Mobley ran to Balleu and Bagheera and hugged them. You are badly injured because of me.
We're all right. You must thank Ka. Said Balleu.
Mobley turned around and looked at the great snake. We are of the same blood, you and I.
Mobley told him in Snake Tong. You speak my language very well. You should go. You must not see what I will do here from now.
Ka then turned and went to the monkeys. They were completely still.
Ka began to dance in front of them. All of the monkeys watched Ka move his body left and right.
None of the monkeys could move. Neither could Balleu and Bagheera. They were all under the python's spell.
Only Mobley was not affected by the snake. Come close to me. Ka ordered.
The monkeys all moved closer. Soded Balleu and Bagheera. Just then Mobley shook Balleu and Bagheera. It broke Ka's spell on them. They woke up.
We must leave this place. Mobley told them. Yes, let's go. But Mobley, keep your hands on us. If you don't, we may go back to Ka. Then he will eat us.
The three of them walked into the jungle. Ka will have a full belly tonight. But Mobley, we suffered because of you. You played with the Bandar Lagh. Then they bit us and hit us. Said Bagheera.
Mobley hung his hand in shame. I know. I am sorry. He said. It was very wrong of me. The jungle law says you must be punished. Said Bagheera.
You should punish me. Said Mobley. Bagheera hit Mobley. However, Mobley did not cry. They then returned home.
